question: What salvific function does the kāma-seed serve within the eleven-syllable formula?
premises: The context is the eleven-syllable formula.
The kāma-seed is present in this formula.
It is described as delivering from the world.
inference: In the eleven-syllable formula, the kāma-seed acts as the deliverer from worldly existence.
plain_english: In the eleven-syllable formula, the kāma-seed should be the deliverer from the world.
